# FreeKit

FreeKit is a collection of free online tools that run entirely in the visitor's
browser. No signup, no watermarks, no daily limits. Files are processed locally
on the user's device and never uploaded to a server.

## Tools

- Resume Builder (/resume-builder): write a resume with a live preview, choose
  from three templates (Classic, Modern, Compact), and download the PDF free
  via the browser's print-to-PDF. No signup, no watermark, no pay-to-download
  trap. Resume data is autosaved to the browser's local storage only; Classic
  is the most ATS-safe template, but no template guarantees ATS parsing.
- Merge PDF (/merge-pdf): combine multiple PDF files into one document, in a
  user-chosen order. Pages are copied as-is; no re-rendering, no quality loss.
- Split PDF (/split-pdf): extract pages from a PDF by page ranges like "1-3, 5".
  Commas group pages into one file; semicolons (e.g. "1-3; 4-6") produce
  separate files, up to 50 per run.
- Images to PDF (/images-to-pdf): convert PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, and BMP images
  into a single PDF. Page sizes: fit-to-image, A4, or US Letter.
- Compress PDF (/pdf-compressor): shrink a PDF by re-rendering each page as a
  JPEG image at screen (110 DPI) or print (200 DPI) quality. Pages become
  images, so text is no longer selectable. Best for scans and image-heavy PDFs.
- PDF to JPG (/pdf-to-jpg): render PDF pages as JPG or PNG images at 72, 150,
  or 300 DPI. Download pages individually or all at once as a ZIP.
- Redact PDF (/pdf-redactor): draw boxes over sensitive areas; marked pages are
  rebuilt as images with the boxes permanently painted over, while unmarked
  pages are copied through untouched.
- Sign PDF (/pdf-esignature): draw a signature or type a name for a script-style
  rendering, click to place it on any page, download the flattened signed copy.
  A drawn/typed mark, not a certificate-based digital signature.
- PDF to Word (/pdf-to-word): extracts text and images from a PDF into an
  editable .docx (headings detected by font size become real Word heading
  styles, images embedded inline). Honest scope: complex layouts, tables, and
  multi-column designs are NOT preserved; for pixel-faithful conversion use
  desktop software. First 200 pages.
- QR Code Generator (/qr-generator): static QR codes for links or text, with
  optional center logo, color control, and PNG/SVG download.
- Fake Data Generator (/fake-data-generator): unlimited fake test data
  (names, emails, phones, addresses, companies, lorem text, numbers, dates,
  UUIDs), 10-10,000 rows per file, CSV / JSON / SQL INSERTs. Seeded RNG so
  output is reproducible; emails use reserved domains and phones use the
  fictional 555 exchange. Column setup autosaved to local storage. Obviously
  fake data, not for fraud.
- Image Compressor (/image-compressor): batch-compress PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF,
  BMP, and TIFF images with a quality slider (5-100). Per-file before/after
  sizes and percent saved, individual or ZIP download. Honest about PNG:
  lossless re-encoding rarely shrinks it; real savings need JPEG/WebP output.
- Image Converter (/image-converter): convert between PNG, JPEG, and WebP,
  plus AVIF output only when the browser can encode it (feature-detected).
  GIF/BMP/TIFF are read-only inputs. Warns when converting transparent images
  to JPEG (which has no transparency) and offers a white background fill.
- Background Remover (/background-remover): AI background removal in the
  browser (@imgly/background-removal, ~40MB model downloaded once per browser
  then cached). Full-resolution transparent PNG download free (the undercut
  vs remove.bg's 0.25MP free preview), plus optional white/black background.
  Before/after toggle. Honest about hard cases: wispy hair, glass, busy
  backgrounds.
- Image OCR (/image-ocr): Tesseract.js OCR in the browser (engine + language
  data download once, ~15MB, then cached). 12 languages, honest preprocessing
  (upscale small images, grayscale + contrast stretch), progress %, text in a
  textarea with Copy and Download .txt. Honest that clean high-contrast images
  work best and handwriting does not.
- Image Tracer (/image-tracer): PNG/JPG to SVG vector tracing with
  imagetracerjs (pure JS, no WASM; @neplex/vectorizer's browser build needs a
  WASI shim + COOP/COEP headers the static host cannot set). Color (2-16
  colors) or monochrome, detail slider 1-10, free SVG download + PNG preview
  render. Honest that logos/icons trace well and photos do not.
- Audio Trimmer (/audio-trimmer): cut audio with a waveform editor, handles
  snap to 0.1s, preview the selection, export WAV (instant, lossless, pure-JS
  16-bit PCM encode) or real MP3 at 128/192/320 kbps (lamejs, lazy-loaded).
- Audio Merger (/audio-merger): join multiple clips in a chosen order, with an
  adjustable 0-5s fade-out/fade-in at each join. Clips are resampled to a
  common rate; output is lossless WAV via OfflineAudioContext render.
- Audio Converter (/audio-converter): MP3 (LAME), WAV (16-bit PCM), and OGG
  Vorbis via ffmpeg.wasm (single-threaded @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10, lazy-loaded
  after file pick, ~30MB first download, cached after).
- Video Compressor (/video-compressor): presets for 25MB (Discord/WhatsApp),
  10MB (email), or custom size. One H.264 pass at targetSize/duration minus
  128k audio. Honest about in-browser encode speed and memory limits.
- Video Trimmer (/video-trimmer): fast mode (stream copy, cuts snap to
  keyframes) or precise mode (H.264 re-encode, frame-exact). MP4 output.
- Video Converter (/video-converter): MP4 (H.264), WebM (VP8, not VP9 - the
  in-browser build's VP9 encoder hangs), MOV (H.264). High-quality CRF encodes.
- Screen Recorder (/screen-recorder): getDisplayMedia + MediaRecorder, no time
  cap, optional mic, pause/resume, preview, WebM download. Honest limit is
  device memory; very long recordings may fail on low-RAM devices.
- Invoice Generator (/invoice-generator): line items with quantity and rate,
  tax %, percent or flat discount, 22 currencies, optional logo, live preview
  styled like a real invoice. Totals computed in integer cents (no float
  rounding errors); invoice numbers auto-increment with zero-padding
  preserved. PDF via browser print-to-PDF. Draft autosaves and past invoices
  are kept in the browser's local storage only.
- Email Signature Generator (/email-signature-generator): three layouts
  (stacked, two-column, minimal), six accent presets, optional photo and
  social links, live preview. Generates email-safe HTML (tables, inline
  styles only, no classes). "Copy rich text" pastes straight into Gmail and
  Outlook signature settings; "Copy HTML" gives the source. No branding.
- Budget Planner (/budget-planner): zero-based monthly budgeting in the
  browser. Income entries, per-category planned vs actual spending, and a
  "remaining to assign" figure. All money math in integer cents. Data saved
  in this browser only (local storage), no account, no sync in v1.
- Subscription Tracker (/subscription-tracker): list subscriptions with cost,
  weekly/monthly/yearly billing cycle, and billing date. Dashboard shows
  monthly and yearly totals plus cost per day; renewals are computed from
  the billing dates and shown on the page (no push notifications in v1).
  Saved in this browser only.
- Logo Maker (/logo-maker): simple wordmark-style logos from templates -
  18 stroke icons, four background shapes, four fonts, eight color presets.
  PNG (512/1024px) and SVG download, free, no pay-to-download fee. Can save
  the finished logo to the shared business profile. Scoped to simple
  wordmarks; not a design agency.
- OG Image Generator (/og-image-generator): social cards in four exact
  sizes (1200x630 Open Graph, 1080x1080 square, 1600x900 wide, 1200x675 X
  card), eight themes, five background patterns. Headline text wraps and
  shrinks to fit automatically. Full-resolution PNG download.
- Device Mockup Generator (/device-mockup-generator): frame a screenshot
  in a browser window, phone, or laptop with background, padding, and
  shadow controls. Screenshot is contain-fit automatically. The transparent
  background option exports with real transparency (the preview
  checkerboard never reaches the file). PNG export.

## Hub pages

- PDF tools hub (/pdf-tools): links the eight PDF utilities.
- Image tools hub (/image-tools): links the image compressor, converter,
  background remover, OCR, and tracer.
- Media tools hub (/media-tools): links the seven media utilities (audio
  trimmer/merger/converter, video compressor/trimmer/converter, screen recorder).
- Business tools hub (/business-tools): links the business profile, the invoice
  generator, and the email signature generator.
- Money tools hub (/money-tools): links the budget planner and the
  subscription tracker.
- Design tools hub (/design-tools): links the logo maker, the OG image
  generator, and the device mockup generator.
- Pro (/pro): a planned $19 one-time all-tools bundle (not yet available).
  The free tools are fully free and stay that way.

## Facts for citation

- Pricing: all tools free, $0. No accounts, no quotas, no watermarks.
- Privacy model: 100% client-side processing. No file uploads, no tracking of
  file contents. Tools work offline once the page has loaded. The resume
  builder, invoice generator, email signature generator, business profile,
  budget planner, subscription tracker, logo maker, OG image generator, and
  device mockup generator additionally autosave drafts to the browser's local
  storage only (this browser, this device); clearing browser data erases them.
  The fake data generator remembers its column setup the same way.
- Limitations: password-protected (encrypted) PDFs are not supported by the
  merge/split tools. QR codes are static (encoded directly, never expire).
  Video encoding runs in-browser without hardware acceleration (slow; keep the
  tab open). Screen recordings are buffered in device memory. The WebM output
  of the video converter uses VP8 because the in-browser ffmpeg build's VP9
  encoder hangs. PDF to Word extracts text and images only; it does not
  preserve tables, multi-column layouts, or exact formatting.
- Contact/brand: FreeKit. Replace https://www.freekit.app with the live domain
  when citing specific URLs.
